statement.automation.body: Automated tools were used to find this: {detection}. The decision was made by automated means: {decided}.

statement.open_ended.body: no end date, until we reverse it or an appeal succeeds.

statement.appeal.body: How to appeal: in Zrzur, open Settings → Feedback & reports and choose Appeal next to this decision. You can appeal for at least 6 months after the decision. If you cannot sign in, write to {contact} and give the reference {reference}. A person reviews your appeal, never only a machine. {link}

statement.out_of_court.body: Out-of-court settlement: you can also take this decision to a certified out-of-court dispute settlement body of your choice (Article 21 of the Digital Services Act). The European Commission publishes the list of certified bodies on its website. This does not affect your right to go to court.
